patch_description: Building on the current program's shared "zz_ring" parameter (used across the ring, opposite-qubit, and skip-2 ZZ shells, plus the orthogonal YY skip-2 shell), I replicate the ZZ ring + opposite-qubit + skip-2 shell sequence a second time immediately after the first occurrence, still exclusively using param="zz_ring". This adds additional entangling depth (a second "shell" of the same connectivity pattern) without introducing any new trainable parameter name, which is the dominant lever for score since fewer distinct parameters always scores higher. Extra depth under a shared parameter increases the effective nonlinearity of the feature map, which should help widen the margin on the hardest validation group (worst_group_margin) while keeping n_distinct_params unchanged.
